title: Software Engineer I-1
description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Software Engineer I-1
Who is Mastercard?
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
Overview
The Mastercard Payment Networks team is looking for a Developer to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem-solving. Our solutions are built on the Digital Network Architecture, around Cloud Native principles and in a Scaled Agile Framework. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.
The Role
• Senior Developer with adequate skills in high quality development.
• Develop in a CICD environment leveraging any one of the Cloud frameworks.
• Leverage the appropriate persistence mechanisms such as RDBMS, No SQL etc based on needs
• Implement Coding Best Practices. Implement Code Quality gates as per the program norms.
• Perform various Proofs-of-concept depending on the business needs
• Coordinate with various groups in MasterCard to ensure success of the projects
• Exhibit teamwork aligned completely with the Agile environment
All About You
• Passionate about technology, with strong Object-Oriented Design & Programming skills
• In depth knowledge on product development
• Expertise in Java and Spring Boot. Experience working on Event Driven Architecture would be an advantage.
• Experience in CI and CD
• Experience in Cloud based development is desirable
• Strong Communicator
• Quick grasping and learning abilities
Corporate Security Responsibility
Every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security. All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and therefore, it is expected that the successful candidate for this position must:
• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices.
• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**


Role Overview


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Advanced AI Practice within the AI Application Engineering team. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to build core DevOps skills while getting direct exposure to the infrastructure that powers Generative AI and Agentic AI applications. You will work under the guidance of senior AI engineers and DevOps managers to build, automate, and maintain the CI/CD, cloud, and container platforms our applied AI teams rely on.


Key Responsibilities


**Platform ownership:** Support end\-to\-end DevOps/MLOps/LLMOps infrastructure for AI application engineering initiatives across on\-prem, hybrid, and multi\-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) environments.


**CI/CD pipelines:** Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and model\-deployment workflows using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or GitHub Actions.


**Containerization \& orchestration:** Package applications and services using Docker; support deployment and day\-to\-day operations on Kubernetes clusters.


**Infrastructure automation:** Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) for provisioning cloud resources under senior engineers' guidance.


**AI application deployment support:** Assist in deploying and operating model\-serving and GenAI/agentic application components and follow established practices for model versioning and rollout.


**AI/LLM infrastructure:** Enable scalable, cost\-efficient model\-serving and agentic\-application infrastructure including GPU orchestration, autoscaling for LLM inference, model registries, and vector database infrastructure.


**Monitoring \& troubleshooting:** Set up and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting for applications and infrastructure; triage and resolve production issues, escalating as needed.


**Security hygiene:** Support routine security practices including vulnerability scanning, patching, and secrets management as per team standards.


**Collaboration:** Work closely with data scientists, ML/AI engineers, and senior DevOps team members to understand deployment requirements and translate them into infrastructure tasks.


**Documentation:** Maintain clear runbooks, deployment guides, and automation documentation for the team.


**Continuous learning:** Stay current with evolving DevOps, MLOps, and LLMOps tooling, and proactively bring in improvements to existing pipelines and practices.


Must\-Have Skills \& Experience (Mandatory)


**2\+ years of hands\-on experience** in DevOps/Infrastructure/Site Reliability engineering.


**Scripting proficiency in Python and/or Bash**; working knowledge of Ansible.

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Vice President, Software Engineering
Role Overview
Mastercard is seeking a Vice President of Software Engineering to lead a strategic engineering organization responsible for delivering enterprise capabilities that enable configuration, onboarding, validation, certification, and lifecycle management.
This leader will be responsible for defining and executing technology strategy, product delivery, platform modernization, operational excellence, and organizational leadership necessary to scale these capabilities and support Mastercard's evolving business needs.

• Partner with business and product leaders to align technology investments with strategic business priorities.
• Develop multi-year engineering roadmaps that balance innovation, operational stability, and customer needs.
Drive Product Delivery and Business Outcomes
• Partner closely with Product Management to translate business strategy into executable engineering plans.
• Establish outcome-based delivery practices focused on customer value, business impact, and measurable results.
• Ensure successful delivery of strategic initiatives across multiple global teams and stakeholder groups.
Enable Digital Transformation
